heading: CNN, MS NOW, Politico Sue Over Trump’s White House Press Ban
author: Bloomberg News Editorial
paragraphs: CNN, MS NOW and Politico filed a lawsuit seeking to allow their journalists to enter the White House grounds days after President Donald Trump revoked their access, turning to the courts in their fight over constitutional protections for the press. Kailey Leinz explains why all major news outlets are banding together and why you might see less televised coverage out of the White House until this resolves (Source: Bloomberg)
